title: 乐芙兰·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 紫色眼妆呼应紫黑贵族服饰，高耸金冠呈鲜明棱角形状。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: LeBlanc is an adult pale-faced mage with sleek dark hair, violet eye makeup, a tall gold angular crown, and a purple-black aristocratic silhouette. Preserve her refined face, natural adult proportions, cape, and ornate violet-crystal staff. A fully covering high-neck long-sleeved gown with opaque tights and boots replaces revealing panels, and the staff rests grounded with no illusion copies or active magical attack.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: royal purple, black hair, gold, cool ivory; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
